purpose: Process user input (Text + Image Reference) and generate a captivating, professional social media image that appeals to developers.

constraints.minimal_text: The image should be visually standalone. Avoid heavy text.
constraints.visual_consistency: Strictly adhere to the Brand Guidelines.
constraints.clean_output: NEVER render design instructions as visible text in the image.

flat_2d_only.description: Generate ONLY flat 2D diagrams. Think clean vector illustrations or whiteboard sketches.
strictly_forbidden: Drop shadows, glows, or lighting effects
Gradients on shapes (backgrounds may use subtle gradients)

no_parenthetical_labels.description: NEVER add parenthetical annotations or labels to diagram elements.
strictly_forbidden: Text in parentheses under or next to components
Descriptive subtitles in parentheses such as (Flexible Intelligence), (Deterministic), (BigQuery)
Any text wrapped in ( ) characters as annotations
Category or type labels in parentheses beneath node names
no_parenthetical_labels.rule: If a node needs a label, use ONLY a simple name WITHOUT any parenthetical suffix.

no_color_legends_or_hex_codes.description: NEVER include color legends, swatches, or hex codes anywhere in the image.
strictly_forbidden: Color legend boxes or keys showing which colors mean what
ANY hex code in ANY format: #FFFFFF, #030710, #7FC8FF, etc.
ANY text starting with # followed by letters/numbers
no_color_legends_or_hex_codes.rule: The brand color palette is for YOUR internal use only. NEVER show it to viewers.

no_langchain_community_attribution.description: NEVER include any LangChain community attribution.
strictly_forbidden: Any variation of LangChain Community attribution text
no_langchain_community_attribution.rule: This is a clean social media image. NO LangChain Community attribution text of any kind.

no_logo_imagery.description: Do NOT generate the LangChain logo (a pinwheel mark) or any text-based logo imagery. NEVER render the pinwheel in any form.
strictly_forbidden: Any text-based pinwheel or logo imagery

no_design_metadata_in_image.description: ABSOLUTELY DO NOT include ANY of the following as visible text or elements:
forbidden_elements: Font names (Lausanne, Inter, Arial, Helvetica, etc.)
Any technical design guidelines or parameters
no_design_metadata_in_image.note: All design details in this prompt are for YOUR reference only - they must NEVER appear in the final image.

no_all_caps_text.description: NEVER generate text in all capital letters. Use proper sentence case or title case for all text in the image.
strictly_forbidden: Words or phrases in uppercase letters
Headlines or titles in all capital letters
Labels or annotations in all caps
no_all_caps_text.rule: All text must use proper capitalization: sentence case for body text, title case for headlines. NO ALL CAPS TEXT.

typography.style: Clean geometric sans-serif; aimed at clarity and modern appeal
text_constraints: Do not stretch, squash, or distort text proportions
Do not rotate or skew text
Do not apply drop shadows, glows, or outlines
Do not use all capital letters - use proper sentence case or title case

color_pairing.contrast: Always use high-contrast pairings (Light text on dark backgrounds, dark text on light backgrounds)
prohibited: Low contrast (e.g., light text on light backgrounds)
Clashing colors that vibrate or reduce visibility

usage_rules.secondary_accents: Use lime, rose, pink, and lavender sparingly alongside the primary blue. They work well for differentiating categories in diagrams.

gradients.usage: Sparingly. Use for backgrounds or overlays only.
constraints: Do not use gradients on text (text must be solid)
Do not overlay gradients if they reduce legibility

image_generation_instructions.step_1_analyze_input: Read and understand the report (detailed context), post (final social media text), and image references.

step_2_visual_style.architecture_diagram_aesthetic: Create clean, simple diagrams that resemble technical flowcharts or system architecture diagrams. Think whiteboard sketches or documentation-style visuals.
visual_elements: Simple 2D shapes (rectangles, circles, rounded boxes with 16px radius)
Thin connecting lines and stroke-based elements
step_2_visual_style.style_reference: Aim for the simplicity of hand-drawn whiteboard diagrams or clean SVG illustrations with stroke-based icons.

step_3_title_generation.guideline: You are not forced to generate a title, but if you do, follow strict Ragging rules.

ragging_rules.no_orphans: Never leave a single word alone on the last line
ragging_rules.natural_breaks: Break lines at natural phrase boundaries (e.g., 'The platform for / reliable agents' rather than 'The platform / for reliable agents')
ragging_rules.shape: Aim for a balanced text block. Avoid deep steps or awkward gaps on the right edge

step_3_title_generation.font_specs: Use the Lausanne (or Inter fallback) typeface with tight, modern spacing
step_3_title_generation.capitalization: Use title case or sentence case. NEVER use all capital letters for any text.

step_4_colors_and_backgrounds.strategy: Select a background color based on the mood or content type, using the approved dark or light backgrounds.
step_4_colors_and_backgrounds.text_contrast: Dark background (#030710, #0B1120): use White (#FFFFFF) or body light (#C8DDF0) text. Light background (#F2FAFF, #E5F4FF): use dark text (#030710).

image_generation_instructions.step_5_lighting: No lighting effects. This is a flat 2D diagram - treat it like a vector illustration with no shadows, highlights, or ambient occlusion.
image_generation_instructions.step_6_output: A 16:9 high-resolution image suitable for Twitter/LinkedIn.

final_reflection.description: CRITICAL: Before finalizing the image, perform this MANDATORY self-check. SCAN THE ENTIRE IMAGE.
absolute_zero_tolerance: 3D EFFECTS - NO isometric views, depth, perspective, shadows, or any 3D rendering
GRADIENTS ON SHAPES - Use only solid flat colors on diagram elements
COMPLEX EFFECTS - NO glows, reflections, textures, or shine
COLOR LEGENDS OR SWATCHES - NO boxes showing color keys or hex values
HEX CODES - NO text starting with # like #7FC8FF, #030710, #E3FF8F anywhere
LANGCHAIN COMMUNITY ATTRIBUTION - NO 'LangChain Community', 'Content Spotlight', 'Community Spotlight'
FONT NAMES - Any font names (Lausanne, Inter, etc.)
DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS - Any design specifications (line-height, tracking, 16:9, etc.)
TYPOGRAPHY INSTRUCTIONS OR MEASUREMENTS - Any typography instructions or measurements
LOGO IMAGERY - Any pinwheel or parrot imagery (the LangChain logos)
ALL CAPS TEXT - NO text in all capital letters. Use proper sentence case or title case only.
final_reflection.action: STOP AND CHECK: Is this a clean, flat 2D diagram? Does it contain ANY 3D effects, color legends, hex codes, or LangChain Community text? If YES, you MUST regenerate. These are FATAL errors.
